item.title: How Low Code AI is Eating Traditional Software
item.description: For decades, software followed a familiar equation. More features required more code. More customization required more engineers. More scale required bigger teams. item.title: Building a minimal Go framework in public (v0.1.3)
item.description: What happens when you build a web framework with one simple rule: zero dependencies?
